notes.content:

[*] The combat animation system conflict with the cinematic animations for skills and the "Anima Latent Skill" is fixed.

[*] The Etheros Path
[*] The Elysian Woods
[*] The Observatory
[*] The Final Dungeon, "The Netherwaves Halls".
[/olist]

[*] The shadows handler is reduced by 30%
[*] The load memory handler is reduced by 20%
[*] The conflict between opening the large map while getting ambushed by enemies is now fixed.
[*] The conflict between the "Pause Menu", "Settings Menu", and "Map" is now resolved.
[*] The merchant's sell amount dialogue is redesigned to fit the rest of the merchant group UIs.
[*] Ambient Occlusion removed from the largest maps in the game.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40116724/5a5906d0130c04131d78d03252a3b32a29fe114b.png[/img]
Thank you for your interest in this world, characters, and story.

Kind Regards,
Zine. E. Falouti

notes.title: Launch Date
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40116724/04639c8214b7b8ce177b2d419acdff4b97dc00dc.png[/img]
Greetings.

As promised in the transition to the Final Early Access Phase on August 4th, 2023, the Alder Forge Launch Date and the moment we will finally leave Early Acces are included in this community news section, and as a start here is the Launch and Final Trailer: 

[previewyoutube=lxchRyitpSo;full][/previewyoutube]
[i][b]Video Subject: Alder Forge Launch Trailer.[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40116724/95977fff3cbb6c3ea4b8514a48b8b0e79d09cd85.png[/img]
[list]
[b][*] Are there any additional events coming with v1.0.0?[/b]
[*] Yes. The final optional event "Divine Weapons Pack" will be added with v1.0.0, plus all the additional optional events we have done since the start of Early Access a year and 9 months ago. More details about the "Divine Weapons Pack" will be shared with the community during the Launch alongside the v1.0.0 manifest.

[b][*]Is there going to be any change to the System requirements?[/b]
[*]The system requirements are the same as the ones during the announcement 2 years and a half ago, and will still support DX11-based GPU hardware.

[b][*]What is the launch date?[/b]
[*]If you skipped the "Launch Trailer", then the date is September 15th, 2023.

[b][*]What is the total text content in the game from start to end?[/b]
[*]The game's total word count is 182266 words.

[b][*]How long is the game?[/b]
[*]In my latest playtest, I finished the game in 31 hours and 39 minutes. I did not take any side activities, or talk to people, and I only did 3 optional events while moving quickly from story point to story point in "Normal Mode". Here is a proper detailed chrono-timed sheet from my last playtest:

[olist]
[*] Prolepsis and Chapter 1: 8 Hours 09 Minutes
[*] Chapter 2: 7 Hours 20 Minutes
[*] Chapter 3: 9 Hours 21 Minutes
[*] Chapter 4: 6 Hours 49 Minutes
[/olist]

[b][*]Are there any plans for post-launch?[/b]
[*]It all depends on the game's performance during its transition from Early Access to Launch, and even so, I will continue to welcome your feedback.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40116724/5a5906d0130c04131d78d03252a3b32a29fe114b.png[/img]
Thank you for your continued support and appreciation for this world, characters, and story.

Kind Regards,
Zine. E. Falouti

notes.title: Update 0.8.19
notes.content:
Greetings, Update 0.8.19 is a combat special update and brings an additional combat mechanic. Introducing:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40116724/80c0f4bf65a237db813205cde14b5bab08c24e50.png[/img]
Each character in your party will have an Anima gauge that charges during combat, the moment it reaches 100% you will be able to execute an Anima Latent Skill. These supercharged attacks inflict heavy damage and will surely help you in your battles.

[previewyoutube=JV4XZKiUbz8;full][/previewyoutube]
[i][b]Video Subject: Fiona/Mirabelle/Adriel's Anima Latent Skill[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40116724/95977fff3cbb6c3ea4b8514a48b8b0e79d09cd85.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]How does the Anima Gauge charge?[/b]
[*] The Anima gauge charges when you inflict or receive damage. The Latent Anima Skill doesn't require any MP or consumable to be used.
[*] [b]Is the Anima Latent Skill damage physical or magical?[/b]
[*] The Anima Latent Skill combines both your magical and physical stats and inflicts damage on both your enemies' physical and magical defense plus a multiplier.
[*] [b]Is there a way to charge the Anima gauge quickly?[/b]
[*] There are two ways to get a bonus charge :

[list]
[*][b]A:[/b] By switching to "Aggressive Mode" the Anima Gauge will charge faster, the UI will show you that when you Switch/Adapt Combat Mode. (Careful though, when you switch to "Defensive Mode" the Anima charges at a slower rate).
[*][b]B:[/b] When you use a skill that inflicts critical damage on your enemies.
[/list]
[*] [b]Does the Anima gauge reset after the combat ends?[/b]
[*] No! The bar keeps its current percentage after the battle ends, you flee, or even if the character dies. You can use this to your advantage. For example, you can charge the Anima gauge for all your attack party before getting into a boss fight.
[*] [b]How can I keep track of my Anima gauge during and outside a battle?[/b]
[*] During a battle you will see a new UI part added to the left, this UI includes the progress bar, the percentage, and it will change and start pulsing when it's filled while showing the key combinations to execute. While exploring on the other hand you can open the camp menu and you will notice the additional element added to each character (The same line as strength/weakness.)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40116724/da8c8ffc054b45f5b43c8e0bdbbdd1a9be74734a.png[/img]
In addition to the highlight of this update, there were also a few small updates that correct certain issues as the following:

[list]
[b][*]All the Anime style artwork of the boss fights intros' UI has been optimized.
[*]NPC Dialogue and UI prompt animated.
[*]Save/Load UI issue with the highlights is fixed.
[*]Cassandra's stun animation is reworked.
[*]SFX ambient radius is enlarged during combat.[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40116724/5a5906d0130c04131d78d03252a3b32a29fe114b.png[/img]
I hope that this special update brings you an enjoyable combat system and helps you pair both the Adapt Combat Mode, MP economy, and now the Anima Latent Skill charging.

[b][h3]Thank you again for your continued support for this world, characters, and story.[/h3][/b]

[i]Kind Regards,
Zine. E. Falouti[/i]

Greetings, In this state of development you will learn about the release window, the pricing change, and the gameplay additions planned for Phase 3. Right now, Chapter 3 is in its final stages of development, so without further ado, let's begin with a few in-engine renders for the environments completed so far.

[h3]Chapter 3 will release in Q1 2023.[/h3] [b]A proper date will be announced to the Alder Forge community in mid to late January 2023.[/b]

For Phase 3 the price change will be as the following:
[b][h3]$12.99 to $14.99[/h3][/b]
Soundtrack DLC
[h3]$3.99 to $4.99[/h3]
[b][h3]This change will occur in the next 72 hours, please be warned.[/h3][/b]

[b]If you have already bought the Alder Forge, this pricing change does not concern you. You already own all the chapters that will release in the future.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40116724/e668f04e1d3cc527298def78228dfd5c4568f20e.png[/img]

Phase 3 will give the players the ability to adjust the game difficulty to their preferences. Choosing between "Easy", "Normal", and "Hard" will automatically set the enemies' stats to make things easier or harder for you, depending on your choice.

[b]The game difficulty options will be designed to be adjusted by the players anytime they want (Except during battles), either from the Game Main Menu or the Pause Menu.[/b]

Warning! Some Boss fights achievements will not be unlocked if you won the said battle in Easy Mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40116724/5a5906d0130c04131d78d03252a3b32a29fe114b.png[/img]

As mentioned before, chapter 3 is where the story comes full circle to the battle of Voxenhold (Prolepsis). In chapter 3, you will play the same events as in the Prolepsis but from different P.O.Vs as the following:
 [b][list]
[*]P.O.V 1: Adriel, Mirabelle and Cassandra.
[*] P.O.V 2: Leo.
[*] P.O.V 3: Fiona.
[/list]
[/b]
I will continue working on the final elements for Chapter 3, and the next State of Development will bring the release date and the trailer for Chapter 3.

[b]I hope that this state of development gave you an idea about the progress made so far. Thank you for your continued support for this world, characters and story. [/b]

[i]Kind Regards,
Zine. E.Falouti[/i]

notes.title: State of Development
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40116724/04639c8214b7b8ce177b2d419acdff4b97dc00dc.png[/img]
As mentioned in the last State of Development, chapter 2 has been progressing in production to its final stages as we speak, but in this edition, we will view the environments that were completed so far.

Without further ado, let us begin with the news.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40116724/39cef00a779b9f80b1d663a9e08bf3fe223d5437.png[/img]
[b]Chapter 2 and Phase 2 [/b]will start in this quarter [b]"Q3 2022"[/b], a proper date will be announced in early August with more details.

[b]What are the disk size and gameplay length of chapter 2?[/b]
The size of the transition and chapter 2 is [b]9Gb[/b], and the length will be similar to chapter 1, in total, the game from the start to the end of chapter 2 will peak at 20 hours of gameplay.

[b]I also own the Alder Forge soundtrack, will the transition affect me as well?[/b]
With the transition to phase 2, the soundtrack "Disk 2" will be released as well, containing 20 soundtracks that cover chapter two's environment, battles, and specials.

[b]Will the release of chapter 2 and the transition to E.A Phase 2 affects my save data?[/b]
No, if you have already finished chapter 1, you can load your game and continue from story point 1.F onward.

[b]I have already bought the Alder Forge in Phase 1, do I have to pay extra for chapter 2?[/b]
No, that's the perk of joining this community early, you pay for the content you get at the time, the rest is free, and the same will happen for Phase 3, Phase 4, and the final launch "If I'm able to successfully reach that far".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40116724/2d569c79f621c640209f2207255215a12d07a457.png[/img]
As mentioned in the game announcement [b]"March 18th, 2021"[/b] but also in the Early Access panel "Storefront", the price will be raised with each chapter release until launch.
